narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives were the same. In month {fork_month} a card turned up unasked, and you chose {real_choice} while the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. That same month {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, and the ghost's money sat above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost held {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. With no pay coming in, the ghost could hold out a little longer, its cushion {safety_gap}.
